visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown and white hand touches the edge of a flat, empty cardboard box on a beige puzzle-patterned floor in a bright indoor room. (2) An orange and white cat walks towards the box, sniffs its edge, and begins to squeeze its body into the opening while the camera moves slightly. (3) The cat is now half-submerged in the box, maneuvering its legs and tail inside while the background shows a child's play area with a tent and toy bins. (4) The cat is fully curled inside the box, looking directly at the camera with its eyes partially closed and its head resting on the cardboard edge. (5) Transition to a different scene where the same cat is tightly curled into a smaller, shallow rectangular box stacked on top of others near a wooden wall; it looks up briefly with an annoyed expression. (6) A top-down view shows the cat curled in a perfect circle within the small box; a white golden spiral graphic is overlaid on its body to illustrate a geometric ratio before it yawns widely. (7) The video ends with a solid pink background featuring a white brand logo and text in the center.

(2) A light rustling sound of cardboard is heard as the cat interacts with the box. (3) BGM continues steadily as short, bright 'pop' and 'bubble' sound effects punctuate visual cuts. (4) The audio texture remains clean with no human speech. (5) A resonant 'ding' or bell-like stinger sounds precisely when the golden spiral graphic appears on screen. (6) The BGM fades out quickly as the final brand logo is displayed.
